inputs.then: time_of_night = epoch index / number of epochs of the night

why_whole_night: time_of_night, the night medians inside the feature block, and the centred means look ahead; the second pass reads the first pass posterior up to 160 epochs away
prepare: NaN and infinities to 0; cut to [-8, 8]; miss = share of the 36 inputs of the epoch that are NaN; present = 1 if any block value of the night is measured
rule: first pass: posterior = softmax(design columns . W + b); second pass: the same design columns plus 55 columns of the first pass posterior (pfeat55), softmax again; stage = the class with the largest posterior of the second pass

fit.target: expert stage labels of open corpora, mixed with the posterior of a net fitted on the same open corpora (target mix)
